install:
set -euo pipefail

# Personal Cursor skills (boxci-github-patch, rad-patch, ...)
SRC="$HOME/.local/share/codegod100-cursor"
if [ -d "$SRC/.git" ]; then
  git -C "$SRC" fetch --depth 1 origin main
  git -C "$SRC" reset --hard FETCH_HEAD
else
  rm -rf "$SRC"
  git clone --depth 1 --branch main https://github.com/codegod100/cursor.git "$SRC"
fi
bash "$SRC/scripts/install-global.sh"
test -f "$HOME/.cursor/skills/boxci-github-patch/SKILL.md"

# Vidya theme crate — clone for local reference (Cargo path dep is ../vidya when sibling exists)
VIDYA="$HOME/.local/share/vidya"
if [ -d "$VIDYA/.git" ]; then
  git -C "$VIDYA" fetch --depth 1 origin main
  git -C "$VIDYA" reset --hard FETCH_HEAD
else
  rm -rf "$VIDYA"
  git clone --depth 1 --branch main https://github.com/codegod100/vidya.git "$VIDYA"
fi
test -f "$VIDYA/Cargo.toml"

# Prefer sibling checkout when the parent of the workspace is writable (matches Cargo.toml path = "../vidya")
PARENT="$(cd .. && pwd)"
if [ -w "$PARENT" ] && [ ! -e "$PARENT/vidya" ]; then
  ln -s "$VIDYA" "$PARENT/vidya"
elif [ -w "$PARENT" ] && [ -L "$PARENT/vidya" ]; then
  ln -sfn "$VIDYA" "$PARENT/vidya"
fi
